svg.aria-label: One change, end to end: capture, ledger, normalize, projection, serve
svg.title: One change, end to end: capture, ledger, normalize, projection, serve
svg.desc: A line with five stations. 01, capture: a watcher sees an agent's file change. 02, ledger: the raw record is kept first, checksummed. 03, normalize: a pure function names what happened. 04, projection: SQLite for reading, FTS5 beside it for search. 05, serve: HTTP for pages, WebSocket for changes. A dotted line runs from the ledger to the projection: on a rebuild the projection is replayed from the ledger, never migrated.
